mapper.sql: cv.id, cv.cause, cv.create_id, cv.create_time, cv.next_deal_id, cv.total_amount, cv.status, ce.id AS creator_id, ce.name AS creator_name, ce.post AS creator_post, nd.id AS dealer_id, nd.name AS dealer_name, nd.post AS dealer_post
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claim_voucher (cause, create_id, create_time, next_deal_id, total_amount, status) VALUES (#{cause}, #{createId}, #{createTime}, #{nextDealId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee ce ON ce.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee nd ON nd.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee ce ON ce.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee nd ON nd.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.create_id = #{createId} ORDER BY cv.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee ce ON ce.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee nd ON nd.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.next_deal_id = #{nextDealId} ORDER BY cv.create_time DESC
